description: This Java class handles the command for creating a dividend for a share product in the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes JSON commands, and delegates the creation logic to ShareProductWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateShareProductDividendCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the creation of share product dividends upon receiving commands, annotated for dependency injection and transaction management.

methods.name: CreateShareProductDividendCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ShareProductWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to create a share product dividend by delegating to the service layer.
